snippet.title: Moon's Creed Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🌙⚔️ THE COSMOS AWAITS YOUR COMMAND ⚔️🌙
Harness the power of the zodiac in MOON'S CREED - where cosmic chaos meets strategic deck-building! ✨
⭐ Choose your hero
♈ Collect zodiac boons from 12 constellations
🃏 Build the perfect deck
🔥 Battle corrupted zodiac signs
🌀 Master the Chaos Chambers
Every run is a new cosmic adventure. Will you restore balance to the universe? 🌌
NOW AVAILABLE on STEAM🎮
